properties.evidence: Same class, one month apart. 2026-08-14: eleven served skills had no slash command, and reflow2's own checkout could not reproduce it because it holds every skill as a source — "the repo actively TEACHES the wrong affordance." 2026-09-14: a capability built here as tools/wall_check.py reaches a consumer through no served tool, no skill and no detector, and this checkout cannot feel it because it has the script. Both are `req:the-tool-finds-its-own-blind-spots` arriving in the environment: the place the decision is made is the one place the defect cannot occur.
